name: Bhagavad Gita 18.66
text:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज ।
अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥
meaning: Setting aside every other duty, take refuge in me alone. I will free you from all wrongs; do not grieve.
purpose: Surrender and release from despair; read within the full context of the Gita.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
